reason: Integrate every pre-return red-team rule frozen in the bound 6.1 amendment into the 6.2 source-semantic admission release before returns are opened.

effective_overrides.same_day_suspend_resume: Only an S row with null or empty suspend_timing proves an absent full-day bar for opportunity completeness. Same-day full-day S and R still prove that day's absence but R clears the state at day end. A non-empty intraday S never proves a missing daily bar and never carries forward; next-open blocking of an observed bar uses only S timing effective no later than the open.
effective_overrides.carried_suspension_state: Stream causally from an earlier explicit full-day S with null or empty suspend_timing. Carry it only while no later R and no actual daily bar has appeared. On t, prior carry can explain a missing active non-ST bar only after subtracting current R; a current full-day S is direct evidence, not carried evidence. A carried missing bar contributes zero amount and zero return and is blocked in sparse pricing. Any actual daily bar or R clears the carried state, and state changes commit only after the entire session validates. Every use is labeled provenance=carried_prior_explicit_full_day_S with ticker, source S date, and official-session age; it must not be described as same-day raw suspension proof.
effective_overrides.st_missing_bar: A stock_st-positive security is excluded before daily-bar completeness. An absent ST bar is omitted, never imputed as a suspension or zero return, and the security cannot later re-enter until its rolling window again contains exactly 20 admitted observations.
effective_overrides.missing_bar_fail_rule: A listed, non-delisted, non-ST security with no daily bar and no explicit S evidence fails the build.
effective_overrides.adj_factor_alias: Inside a verified alias interval the historical vendor-code adj_factor row is authoritative when both vendor and canonical rows exist; outside the interval the canonical code is authoritative. Daily and selected daily_basic fields still require exact equality when both identities overlap.
effective_overrides.security_scope_and_inactive_status: The active roster remains list_date <= t < delist_date. A stock_st row for an identity present in the master but inactive on t is ignored and counted; it never changes listing bounds. An unknown SH/SZ code in daily, daily_basic, stock_st, or suspensions fails as security-master incompleteness. Only an explicit .BJ row is silently excluded as outside the frozen SSE/SZSE scope.
effective_overrides.selection_source_isolation: Train uses exact suspension and strict stock_st cutoff-view artifacts ending 2022-12-31. Validation uses separately named exact artifacts ending 2024-12-31 and cannot share a path or physical file with train. Each stock_st cutoff view copies every admitted Parquet byte-for-byte into a create-only stage-private partition root, rejects symlinks/hardlinks/samefile aliases, binds the private-root payload, revalidates every copied Parquet, and carries no future calendar or unknown source-checkpoint fields. Audit uses a third private root created only after the selected-definition freeze, cannot reuse any train or validation source, and its stock_st view binds the winner-freeze payload.
effective_overrides.exact_replay_integrity: Every train and validation replay binds the complete phase-attributable period rows, trade rows, and daily account-NAV rows, not only aggregate phase statistics. Their canonical trace digests are included inside each frozen phase payload.
effective_overrides.selection_derivation: The winner freeze records both challenger gate maps, the exact ordered train-pass set, validation median turnover used by the registered tie-break, and ten per-phase replay payloads. Verification recomputes the unique winner or null result, requires a full pre-freeze selection commit OID, and proves the freeze path did not exist in that execution commit.
effective_overrides.runtime_capsule: Formal returns run only on the frozen Windows CPython 3.10.16 source package. The runtime binds exact imported distribution versions and non-bytecode file-tree SHA-256 identities, exact Conda Python/NumPy/SciPy/MKL/compression/runtime artifact builds and package SHA-256 identities, plus the active MKL/compiler/SIMD configuration; all are rechecked before and after each formal return opening.
effective_overrides.historical_audit_opening: Before any widened-universe return is opened, the implementation closure fixes the one historical-audit physical market-data cutoff at 2026-08-21. A different cutoff is rejected. The winner freeze, tracked historical-audit evidence, and tracked terminal release result each have one fixed repository path and use create-only publication. Audit status must equal its gate outcome, binds the committed winner freeze and pre-audit execution commit, and a dedicated finalize mode deterministically emits the null-selection or audited terminal result.

required_tests_add: missing stock_st-positive bars are omitted rather than treated as unproved suspensions
same-day full-day S and R rows retain S proof for that missing bar but R clears the carried state without overriding next-open timing
only null/empty-timing full-day S can prove a missing bar or establish causal carry; intraday S cannot carry and current R removes prior proof
carried suspension inference records its earlier S date and official-session age separately from raw same-day evidence
verified alias intervals prefer the historical vendor adj_factor when provider normalizations differ
known inactive stock_st rows are ignored and counted, explicit BJ rows are excluded, and unknown SH/SZ rows fail before filtering
train, validation, and audit status artifacts use strict, mutually distinct physical paths and exact-cutoff stock_st views
stock_st cutoff views own byte-for-byte private partitions and reject samefile, hardlink, symlink, or cross-stage physical reuse
train and validation exact replay detects any change to phase-attributable period, trade, or daily NAV trace rows
winner verification recomputes train passers, validation candidates, turnover tie-break, and the unique winner or null result
the formal runtime rejects distribution byte, Conda artifact build/hash, or MKL/compiler/SIMD drift
historical audit rejects any cutoff other than the pre-selection frozen 2026-08-21 endpoint, enforces gate/status consistency, and refuses to overwrite any terminal artifact
